meta.name: The Gentlemen
meta.description:
When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 7 Mar 2024 · United Kingdom, United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Moonage Pictures, Miramax · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Refined Aggression
videos.overview: When the Duke of Halstead dies, his second son inherits everything, including the title, house and grounds — plus a whole heap of trouble.

videos.title: Tackle Tommy Woo Woo
videos.overview: The toffs and their gamekeeper hunt a new kind of prey. Susie enlists some help to clean up the mess, and Halstead Manor is blessed with a holy visitor.

videos.title: Where's My Weed At?
videos.overview: Jimmy gets distracted on the job. As supply chain issues delay deliveries, the Horniman brothers take a risky ride to placate a dissatisfied customer.

videos.title: An Unsympathetic Gentleman
videos.overview: Susie is keen to expand the business. Eddie is determined that it won't be on his estate, so the Hornimans search for alternative locations.

videos.title: I've Hundreds of Cousins
videos.overview: Distribution issues in Europe and a theft on the farm cause a headache for Eddie and Susie — until they make a new acquaintance who can help them out.

videos.title: All Eventualities
videos.overview: Eddie's doubts about Susie continue to grow. But there's 15 million pounds of dirty money to be laundered before she'll consider leaving the estate.

videos.title: Not Without Danger
videos.overview: Bent on vengeance, Susie goes against her father's orders. Eddie offers to help her but is less certain than ever about where his allegiances lie.

videos.title: The Gospel According to Bobby Glass
videos.overview: A familiar face returns to settle a score with Freddy. Bobby decides it's time to retire and wants Eddie and Susie to make the necessary arrangements.

videos.title: The Road to Kingdom
videos.overview: An Italian gangster, a royal sheikh and a cash-hungry lord join Eddie for a shooting party. With his eyes on a peerage, he needs it to go off with a bang.

videos.title: There's a Rat in the Kitchen
videos.overview: Eddie makes a deal with the Mafia in Milan, while Jack preps for a high-stakes night on the town. But will either be able to deliver on their promise?

videos.title: Do You Reject Satan?
videos.overview: The cost of restoring the Halstead estate to its former glory continues to spiral — while the farm staff's demand for more pay comes at an impossible price.

videos.title: The Bigger Picture
videos.overview: The House of Lords is split down the middle, so Eddie looks to the church for help. But to get the bishops on side, he needs to ruffle a few feathers.

videos.title: A Suburban A-Road on the Outskirts of Basingstoke
videos.overview: Eddie faces the violent consequences of his betrayal — and the cost of his loan. Susie and Joe head to Peru to expand the business behind Bobby's back.

videos.title: The Bells of San Domenico
videos.overview: Marco and Eddie mix business with pleasure amid preparations for the big day. As one guest causes trouble, will the event end in a wedding — or a funeral?

videos.title: This Mad Circus
videos.overview: When Halstead Manor gets overrun with vermin, it's up to Geoff to stamp them out and save his employers. Susie accuses Bobby of tinkering with the plane.

videos.title: Bring Me the Head
videos.overview: A furious Eddie plots his revenge — until Susie steps in. As the truth behind the break-in comes to light, the Horniman family is shaken to its core.
